# Google AI Browser API

Machine-oriented quick guide for AI agents.

Base URL: https://image-ai.toidayhoc.com
OpenAPI: https://image-ai.toidayhoc.com/openapi.json
Human docs: https://image-ai.toidayhoc.com/docs
Extension download page: https://image-ai.toidayhoc.com/extension
Latest extension ZIP: https://image-ai.toidayhoc.com/extension/download
Latest extension metadata: https://image-ai.toidayhoc.com/extension/latest

## Authentication

Execution endpoints require either:
- Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
- X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY

Never put the API key in a URL or log it. GET /health, /docs, /extension, /extension/latest, /extension/download, /llms.txt and /openapi.json are public.

## Required job pattern

1. Send a unique Idempotency-Key with every POST.
2. A POST returns HTTP 200 when completed quickly, or HTTP 202 while queued/running.
3. Save response.id. For HTTP 202, poll GET /jobs/{id} after retryAfterSeconds.
4. Stop at status completed or failed. Do not resend POST merely because work is slow.
5. If the POST response was lost, retry the exact payload with the same Idempotency-Key.

## Chat

POST /chat
Gemini JSON: {"provider":"gemini","prompt":"...","model":"3.5-flash-lite","newConversation":true}
ChatGPT JSON: {"provider":"chatgpt","prompt":"...","model":"default","newConversation":true}
Batch: use "prompts":["...","..."] instead of prompt.
Providers/models: gemini (default) supports 3.5-flash-lite and 3.1-pro; chatgpt supports default.
Result: response for one prompt or responses[] for a batch.

## Text-to-image

POST /generate
Flow JSON: {"provider":"flow","prompt":"...","ratio":"16:9","outputs":1,"worker":"extension"}
ChatGPT JSON: {"provider":"chatgpt","prompt":"...","outputs":1,"worker":"extension"}
Batch: use prompts[]. Maximum 100 prompts per job. Default outputs is 1.
Allowed ratios: 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16.
ChatGPT image currently requires extension, outputs=1, and no referenceImageUrl.
Result: images[].

## Upload a reference image

POST /assets with raw JPEG, PNG or WebP bytes and the matching Content-Type.
The response contains url. Use that URL as referenceImageUrl.

## Image-to-image

POST /generate
JSON: {"prompt":"...","referenceImageUrl":"https://...","ratio":"16:9","outputs":1,"worker":"extension"}
Result: images[].

## Text-to-video

POST /video
JSON: {"prompt":"...","ratio":"16:9"}
Allowed ratios: 16:9, 9:16. Each prompt creates one video.
Result: videos[].

## Image-to-video

Upload the image with POST /assets, then POST /video:
JSON: {"prompt":"...","referenceImageUrl":"https://...","ratio":"16:9"}
Result: videos[].

## Video-to-video / extend a Flow scene

POST /video/extend
JSON: {"sourceFlowUrl":"https://labs.google/fx/vi/tools/flow/project/PROJECT_ID/scene/SCENE_ID","prompt":"..."}
sourceFlowUrl must be a Google Flow scene URL. Arbitrary MP4, S3 URLs and sourceVideoUrl are not accepted.
Result: videos[], flowUrl and durationSeconds. For the next segment, use returned flowUrl as sourceFlowUrl.
Run extensions sequentially for the same scene. Default retries are disabled.

## Errors

401 means the API key is missing or invalid. 4xx means correct the request and do not blindly retry. For status failed, inspect error, failures, and logs. A failure code of provider_quota is not a selector error; do not retry until the provider quota resets.
